optimization_choice: Use scipy.optimize.linprog with default HiGHS backend because scipy is available; pyomo/pulp/linopy/cvxpy wrappers are not installed.
related_work_pdf_status: ReadPDF returned parser errors for all four PDFs and local text extraction tools/modules were unavailable or yielded no text. Related-work findings are therefore limited to task statement and dataset inspection; this limitation is recorded in report.
fallbacks: FES-specific numerical trajectories are not present as separate data files, so future scenarios are modeled as transparent sensitivity cases using capacity/demand/flexibility multipliers inspired by common decarbonisation pathway dimensions.
Use transport network flow constraints rather than full AC/DC power-flow angle physics because links.csv provides capacities and lengths but no reactances.
